url.description: Page address. Accepts a public HTTP or HTTPS URL up to 8192 characters. Supply this or page_id, never both.

page_id.description: Previously read page identifier. Accepts an identifier returned to this client. Reuses its cached snapshot without a network request.

start_line.description: First returned line. Accepts 1–10000, default 1. Larger numbers page through the same snapshot.

max_lines.description: Page size. Accepts 1–500, default 200. Larger values return more numbered lines.
